129.news_title: Version 30 Firmware Now Released on Arcooda Monitors
129.long_description:
With the latest version 30 firmware, Arcooda monitors now support a wider range of arcade game boards on plug and play basis, introduces new OSD languages, and updated features including improvements to picture auto calibration. 

The new firmware supports a wider range of 15khz titles including 50,54 60 and 70Hz titles such as NBA Jam / Mortal Kombat, supports 24khz game titles such as Daytona USA & Virtua Striker, and all 31khz titles up to 1080P.

OSD languages include English, Chinese, Italian, Spanish, German, Portuguese, and French.
